calls.head: Turnovers could swing this one
calls.body: The Sabres give up more dangerous chances after losing the puck than most, and the Wild pounce.
calls.call: The Wild get at least their usual 7.5% of their 5-on-5 chances right after winning the puck.
calls.nums: Minnesota 9th for chances off turnovers (7.5% of their chances come right after winning the puck) · Buffalo 23rd for avoiding breakdowns
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 2 and 2 games this season
calls.happened: 2.2% of Minnesota’s 5-on-5 chances came right after winning the puck, against their usual 7.5%.

calls.head: The Sabres hunt better looks than the Wild
calls.body: On shot quality, Buffalo is near the top of the league and Minnesota is near the bottom of the league. That’s about as far apart as two teams get.
calls.call: The Sabres’ shots are more dangerous on average than the Wild’s.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 2 and 2 games this season
calls.happened: On how dangerous the average shot was, Buffalo had 7.6% a shot and Minnesota 5.3% a shot. Coming in, Buffalo was at 6.5% a shot and Minnesota at 6.2% a shot.
calls.usual: BUF 6.5% a shot · MIN 6.2% a shot
calls.tonight: BUF 7.6% a shot · MIN 5.3% a shot

BUF.head: We had this close to even (53% for Buffalo), and Buffalo came through.

MIN.head: We had this close to even (47% for Minnesota), and it went Buffalo’s way.

surprises.head: Buffalo hardly hit anyone
surprises.body: Buffalo’s hit score in the close stretches of the game was 47, against their usual 95 (100 is league average, adjusted for the arena’s scorer). A team strays this far about once every 20 games.

surprises.head: Buffalo shut down Minnesota’s power play
surprises.body: Minnesota’s power play created 2.5 expected goals per 60, against their usual 7.5 and a league average of 7.5. A team strays this far about once every 20 games.

story.head: The Sabres come back from two down
paras: Danila Yurov opened the scoring late in the second. The Wild led by two, but the Sabres came all the way back. Owen Power won it in overtime.
The score was fair. Replay this game’s chances a hundred times and the Sabres win about four in five.

items.text: One of the preview’s two calls held.
